title: 第4章 根骨第5章 补贴第6章 麻烦
content_zh:

张家沟距离在县城的郭威武馆，有二十里地，赶牛车的话，来回也要半天时间。
昨夜张萍萍和张褚氏已经将该带上的东西都收拾妥当。
张萍萍将一起前往县城，并留下来照顾张凌风饮食起居，让张凌风有更多的时间用在练武上。
“到了武馆不要与人争强斗狠，要听师傅的话。”
张褚氏一脸心疼。
大儿子外出做生意，小儿子又要被送去练武，她很舍不得，叮嘱了张凌风几句后，将一枚银锭塞在了张凌风袖子中。
“知道了娘，孩儿会经常回来看您的。”
张凌风将银锭收好。
张大注意到了，但并没有说什么，而是将收拾好的东西，搬运到牛车上面去。
“小风，记住家里供养你去练武的目的，爷爷等着你好消息。”
张老爷叮嘱道。
“放心吧，爷爷。”
张凌风看了眼地上的纸钱。
那是马家被灭后，送葬队伍从门口路过时留下的纸钱，马家在附近几个村子里的地位，不弱于张家，说没就没了，让许多人神经都绷紧了。
张富贵拄着拐杖站在一旁，张富康右脸还未完全消肿，两人都一脸羡慕的看着张凌风。
“堂哥，等你学到了本事，一定要教我几招。”
张富康说道。
“这是我妈煮熟后的鸡蛋，让给你在路上吃。”
张富贵递过来一袋鸡蛋。

“帮我谢谢婶婶，放心吧，咱们是一家人。”
张凌风摸了摸张富康和张富贵的脑袋，随后和刘丰坐在同一辆牛车，走在前面，张大和张萍萍，则坐在另一辆牛车，一路跟在了后面。
“爹，凌风要去县城练武了，王家怎么没人来送一下。”
张萍萍问道。
“他们今早送来了一袋肉干就走了，他们不看好你弟去武馆练武，认为是白白浪费钱，怕今后家里冷落了人家闺女。”
张大随口说道。
张凌风和王家有一桩亲事。
王家也是地主，拥有良田一千来亩，比张家要富裕不少，张凌风和王家闺女的这桩婚事，在许多人看来张家高攀了王家。
如今张家沟这片地方，大家都知道，张凌风要去练武的事情，不少张家的佃户都松了口气，认为送走了混世魔王。
和张家定亲的王家，则找过张老爷，让张老爷不要杯弓蛇影，将钱留着好好经营田产，别到时候因为张凌风一个人拖垮了整个张家，导致他们闺女嫁过来吃苦。
“我听说他们在县城有座小院子，我要是他们就将那座小院子，暂时先给凌风住，将来凌风要是练武有成，也能够惦记着他们这份情。”

Zhangjiagou is twenty miles away from Guo Wei Martial Arts Hall in the county seat. It would take half a day to drive an ox cart back and forth.
Last night, Zhang Pingping and Zhang Chu had packed everything they needed to bring.
Zhang Pingping will go to the county town together and stay to take care of Zhang Lingfeng's food and daily life, so that Zhang Lingfeng can spend more time practicing martial arts.
"When you get to the martial arts gym, don't fight with others, but listen to the master."
Mrs. Zhang Chu looked distressed.
Her eldest son was away on business, and her younger son was about to be sent to practice martial arts. She was reluctant to let him go. After giving Zhang Lingfeng a few words, she stuffed a silver ingot into Zhang Lingfeng's sleeve.
"I know mother, the child will come back to see you often."
Zhang Lingfeng put away the silver ingots.
Zhang Da noticed it, but didn't say anything. Instead, he carried the packed things to the bullock cart.
"Xiao Feng, remember the reason why your family supports you to practice martial arts. Grandpa is waiting for good news for you."
Master Zhang warned.
"Don't worry, Grandpa."
Zhang Lingfeng glanced at the paper money on the ground.
That was the paper money left behind when the funeral procession passed by the door after the Ma family was destroyed. The Ma family's status in several nearby villages was no less than that of the Zhang family. It was gone at the last word, which made many people nervous.
Zhang Fugui stood aside with a cane, and the swelling on the right side of Zhang Fukang's face had not completely subsided. They both looked at Zhang Lingfeng with envy.
"Cousin, when you learn the skills, you must teach me a few tricks."
Zhang Fukang said.
"These are eggs cooked by my mother for you to eat on the road."
Zhang Fugui handed over a bag of eggs.
"Thank you aunt for me. Don't worry, we are a family."
Zhang Lingfeng touched the heads of Zhang Fukang and Zhang Fugui, then sat in the same ox cart with Liu Feng and walked in front. Zhang Da and Zhang Pingping sat in another ox cart and followed behind.
"Dad, Ling Feng is going to the county town to practice martial arts. Why doesn't anyone from the Wang family come to see him off?"
Zhang Pingping asked.
"They sent a bag of dried meat this morning and left. They don't like your brother going to the martial arts gym to practice martial arts. They think it is a waste of money and they are afraid that the family will neglect their daughter in the future."
Zhang Da said casually.
Zhang Lingfeng and the Wang family have a marriage.
The Wang family is also a landowner, owning over a thousand acres of fertile land, and is much wealthier than the Zhang family. The marriage between Zhang Lingfeng and the daughter of the Wang family, in the eyes of many people, the Zhang family has surpassed the Wang family.
Now everyone in Zhangjiagou knew that Zhang Lingfeng was going to practice martial arts. Many tenants of the Zhang family breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that the Demon King had been sent away.
The Wang family, who were engaged to the Zhang family, approached Mr. Zhang and asked him not to be a swindler and to keep the money to manage the property, so that Zhang Lingfeng would not bring down the entire Zhang family and cause their daughter to marry and suffer hardship.
"I heard that they have a small courtyard in the county. If I were them, I would let Ling Feng live in that small courtyard for the time being. In the future, if Ling Feng succeeds in martial arts, he can also remember their love."
